emphasis_points: Highlight versatile day-to-night transformation, detailing the specific conversion mechanism (click-clack, pull-out trundle, fold-out, or diwan layout).
Describe sleeping surface firmness and supportive padding suited for guests or compact living spaces.

avoid_list: Do not claim the sofa bed replaces an orthopaedic primary mattress unless verified in product specifications.
Do not assume storage compartments or linen storage under seat unless explicitly listed in attributes.
Do not conflate click-clack conversion with pull-out trundle or static diwan frames.
tone_notes: Versatile, welcoming, and efficient, emphasizing seamless transition, spatial smartness, and guest hospitality.
